title: Beauty and the Beast
tagline: Enchanted castle. The cutlery does the serving.
about: A young woman held in an enchanted castle sees past the Beast to the man inside.
cue: Serve the snacks when Lumiere puts on the big dinner show for Belle.

    StartersGaston's eggsTwelve eggs halved and piped with Dijon mayo yolk filling, paprika and chivesHow to make it12 eggs4 tbsp mayonnaise1 tsp Dijon mustard20g soft butter1 tsp smoked paprika1 bunch chivesBoil the eggs hard, cool, peel and halve.Whip the yolks with the mayonnaise, Dijon and butter until smooth.Pipe back into the whites and finish with paprika and chives.Brie, pear and honey baguette toastsToasted baguette slices with brie, sliced pear and a drizzle of honey, served warmHow to make it1 baguette2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil200g brie2 pears1 tbsp honeySlice the baguette and brush with olive oil.Toast at 200°C.Top with sliced brie and a thin slice of pear, return briefly to warm, and drizzle with honey.MainsGaston's tavern roast chickenWhole roast chicken with potatoes and thyme gravy, torn apart at the tableHow to make it1.8kg whole chicken40g buttersalt, to taste1kg potatoes1 bunch thyme300ml chicken stockRub the chicken with butter and salt and chop the potatoes into the tray.Roast at 220°C to start, then lower to 180°C until cooked through.Rest the chicken.Make gravy with the pan juices, thyme and stock. Tear the chicken apart at the table.Castle kitchen beef bourguignonBeef stew for the girl he told to go ahead and starveHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef chuck braised slowly with bacon, baby onions, mushrooms, thyme and a rich grape and beef stock gravy, over buttery mash with crusty bread.Brown 150g diced bacon, then 1.2kg diced beef chuck in batches.Cook 1 onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tbsp flour, then 250ml red grape juice, 500ml beef stock, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, thyme and bay.Return the meat, cover and braise at 160°C for 3 hours.Brown 12 peeled baby onions and 250g mushrooms in butter and stir in.Serve with mashed potato.SweetsEnchanted rose panna cottaRosewater panna cotta topped with crushed raspberries and a sugared rose petalHow to make it3 gelatine leaves600ml thickened cream100g caster sugar1 tsp rosewater150g raspberries4 sugared rose petalsSoak the gelatine leaves in cold water.Warm the cream with most of the sugar, stir in the squeezed gelatine and the rosewater, and pour into four glasses.Set in the fridge.Crush the raspberries with the remaining sugar and spoon on top with a rose petal.Lumière's cookies and cream mousseLumière's dinner show for Belle in the dining roomHow to make itAs written, serves 4Silky cookies and cream mousse of crushed chocolate biscuits, whipped cream and mascarpone, piped into little cups and topped with a crunchy biscuit crumb.Crush 12 chocolate cream sandwich biscuits, keeping 2 tbsp crumbs.Whip 300ml thickened cream with 250g mascarpone, 2 tbsp icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla to soft peaks.Fold through the crushed biscuits so it turns grey.Pipe into 8 small cups or glasses and chill 1 hour.Top with the saved crumbs and a white chocolate curl just before serving.DrinksLeFou's apple slushFrozen apple juice and lemon scraped to slush, topped with marshmallow creamHow to make it1 L cloudy apple juice1 lemon150ml thickened cream3 tbsp marshmallow creme1 box English breakfast teaMix the apple juice with the lemon juice and pour into a tray to freeze.Freeze, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes.Whip the cream and fold in the marshmallow creme.Spoon the slush into glasses and top with the cream. Brew a pot of English breakfast tea for the grown-ups.
